about: The MMORPG's new moments (docs/mmorpg-m7.md J1; docs/weather.md): the ringshadow sweep (rsdrone = the low drone swelling from the 60 s warning as the band comes, a loop; rspass = the pressure-drop whoosh as its edge passes over the pilot; rsbed = the cold airy bed under the band, a loop; rsrelease = the sun coming back; shimmer = the faint crystalline shimmer of ore flaring under the band, a loop), the starfall (sfstreak = the rising whistle-roar of the streak's 10 s, placed toward the impact; sfboom = the impact's deep boom; sfecho = its rolling echo off the hills, a few seconds later; sfcrater = the hot crater's hum and ember crackle, a loop at the deposit) and the progression's news (rankup = the Prospector's level-up sting; blueprint = a blueprint found; paid = a KSTR contract done; made = a module made in the Foundry; research = a mark researched in the Lab). Dusty frontier under a gas giant, the weight of a 1970s alien-invasion score, space: no voices, no music beds; short, mixed to sit under the music. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>).

entries.prompt: deep ominous sub-bass drone, a vast shadow approaching over a desert, slow low pulsing hum with a faint metallic resonance, dark and weighty like a giant machine in the sky, steady, no beat, no melody, no voices
huge low pressure-drop whoosh, air suddenly sucked away as a giant shadow sweeps overhead, deep rushing wind swell that falls into a cold hush, cinematic, no impact, no voices

breathy cold air texture, soft continuous hiss of thin wind and airy whooshing, like standing in the shade on a high cold plateau, wide stereo, gentle and constant, no hum, no tone, no beat, no voices
warm release as sunlight returns, a soft rising airy swell that opens up and settles, gentle warm wind exhale, relief, cinematic, no voices
soft continuous crystalline shimmer, gentle glassy sparkle like wind chimes made of tiny crystals, smooth and even throughout, quiet, steady texture, no sudden changes, no melody, no voices

incoming meteor crescendo: starts as a faint distant high whistle and grows steadily louder and deeper for the whole ten seconds into a huge fiery tearing roar at its loudest at the very end, cut off sharply, no explosion
meteor impact, a massive deep earth-shaking boom with a heavy low thud and debris crumbling down after, huge sub bass, cinematic, outdoor desert
huge meteorite slamming into rocky ground, deep explosive boom, the ground cracking, rocks and dust raining down, powerful low end, outdoor
distant explosion echo rolling across wide canyons and hills, a long low rumbling roll that fades slowly into silence, outdoor desert, no initial bang
hot smouldering meteor crater, a low warm electric hum with soft crackling embers and occasional small pops and hisses of cooling rock, steady, close, no wind, no voices
short triumphant level up sting, a warm brass and twangy electric guitar chord swelling up with a shimmering synth sparkle, space western, bright and proud, ends cleanly, no voices
mechanical unlock, a heavy metal latch clicking open and a small gear whirr, followed by a clear bright bell chime, discovery, short, no voices
short radio confirmation blip, two quick rising electronic beeps through a crackly old radio with a brief squelch, payment received, no voices
a heavy metal part clanks down on a steel workbench, then a clear sustained warm electronic tone rings out and fades, machine part finished, short, no voices
laboratory discovery, a soft electronic scanner sweep and a light metallic click, then a clear rising two-note synth tone, research complete, short, no voices
